key_insight: The paper maps FIR filtering into a unitary state-space quantum circuit, introducing a quantum delay gate to enable sample-based signal processing on a quantum computer.
engineering_relevance: This offers a reusable building block for quantum signal processing pipelines, with potential future speedups when combined with amplitude estimation and fault-tolerant hardware.
method: Formulate FIR filtering in a state-space representation compatible with unitary quantum circuits.
Implement a quantum delay gate as the discrete-time delay-line analog.
Approximate bounded filters, such as lowpass behavior, via a projection-operator emulation.
evidence_signal: The approach was implemented and demonstrated using a quantum circuit simulator, validating the circuit design at the proof-of-concept level.
watch_item: Because the construction is unitary, it is naturally suited to lossless systems and may require careful approximation or emulation for general dissipative filters.
paper_title: State-Space-Based FIR Filtering on a Quantum Computer
